title: 云计算和 SaaS 行业迎来新动向
core_insight: 云计算和 SaaS 行业正在朝着更加智能化和自动化的方向发展，AI 应用成为新的增长点

dimension_texts.technology: AWS 推出 Amazon Bedrock AgentCore，支持生产 AI 代理的持久计算；Google Cloud 推出 BigQuery Graphs 和 Gemini 企业版，增强云原生能力；Azure 推出 GPT-5.6，火山引擎发布大数据产品 AWS DynamoDB 现在支持实时向量搜索，具有单位毫秒级延迟和 99%+ 的召回率；Google Cloud 加速 PostgreSQL 迁移和 AI 应用；Azure 推出 Brain AI 系统，Cloudflare 发布 Certificate Transparency Monitoring AWS Weekly Roundup: AWS Heroes Summit, Web Search on Amazon Bedrock, Dogwood, Kiro Crew, and more (August 10, 2026) Amazon DynamoDB now supports real-time vector search at any scale Using BigQuery Graphs with measures for trusted agentic workloads Accelerate PostgreSQL migrations using Gemini in Database Migration Service The Economics of Agent Optimization 火山引擎正式推出四款数据产品 Introducing Radar Researcher: An AI tool for exploring Internet data in plain language
dimension_texts.infrastructure: AWS 推出新区域和定价策略；Google Cloud 推出新区域和定价策略；Azure 扩大区域覆盖 AWS 提供更多算力和 GPU 供应，以支持 AI 和机器学习应用；Google Cloud 增强算力供应和芯片支持；火山引擎发布云计算产品 AWS Weekly Roundup: Local Zone in Athens, Claude Opus 5 on AWS, Lambda durable execution for .NET, and more (July 27, 2026) Expanding connectivity in the Americas: Introducing Alisios, Canoa, and OlaLuz subsea cables AT&T and Microsoft scale trillion-token workloads with Microsoft Foundry and AMD 布局云计算，火山引擎的技术发展之路
dimension_texts.application: Salesforce 推出 Headless 360，支持 AI 驱动的客户服务和支持；SaaS 厂商竞争日趋激烈，HubSpot 推出新功能和比较；Azure 推出 AI-Augmented Code Modernization Tools 企业上云和数字化转型加速 Scale Customer Support With AI Agents: 5 Service Tips For SMBs Pardot alternatives: What B2B marketers are choosing now HubSpot AEO vs. Profound: Features, pricing, and use cases Microsoft named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for AI-Augmented Code Modernization Tools 字节跳动是如何建设云的？
